skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Moon Catastrborn
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Moon Catastrborn. The actor plays the role of the heir of bane who descends upon Terra after rending the moon into twins. The hero stands no chance in a head-on fight.
skins.quote: Everybody knows Blemishine isn't cut out to be the bad guy, but isn't that what makes it fun? Anyway, she and her family there are just out to have fun, they're not in it to win or lose.
